source.name: volume_patterns.py::detect_volume_anomaly
source.note: Fixed indicator implementation and dictionary give numerical thresholds; qualitative article does not itself supply all these windows. Insufficient or invalid inputs are UNKNOWN, not source defaults.

kb_yidong_is.meaning: 65 valid-history eligibility, today volume / prior 5-bar mean >= 2 and pct_chg >= 2

kb_yidong_james.meaning: 65 valid-history eligibility, volume ratio >= 3, pct_chg >= 5 and at least 3 bullish candles among the latest 5

kb_yidong_type.meaning: 詹姆斯级 or 徐杰级 on a known hit; null if no hit or classification unknown

kb_yidong_status.meaning: source-rule eligibility / input validity, distinguishing incomplete data

kb_yidong_vol_ratio_5.meaning: today volume divided by mean volume of the 5 preceding bars

kb_yidong_bullish_count_5.meaning: latest 5 bars with close strictly greater than open, including today

kb_yidong_ma60_distance_pct.meaning: current close relative to the current bound MA60, percentage points; not the pre-rise anchor

kb_yidong_yellow_distance_pct.meaning: current close relative to the current bound yellow line, percentage points; not the pre-rise anchor

kb_yidong_vol_peak_5.meaning: maximum volume of the latest 5 bars including today

kb_yidong_vol_peak_prior20.meaning: maximum volume in the 20 bars before those latest 5 bars

kb_yidong_peak_ratio_5_20.meaning: latest-5 maximum divided by preceding-20 maximum

kb_yidong_price_volume_up_days_5.meaning: latest 5 bars where close > previous close and volume > previous volume; descriptive comparison, not an authenticated 放量上涨 definition

kb_yidong_phase_anchor_date.meaning: null until rise/pullback anchor selection is confirmed

kb_yidong_phase_status.meaning: ANCHOR_RULE_NOT_QUANTIFIED: rise/pullback segment and support definitions are pending

phase_gaps.pre_rise: A pre-rise anchor is not uniquely specified; current MA60/yellow distances are not mislabeled as pre-rise distances.
phase_gaps.pullback: Peak drawdown, volume divided by rise-phase volume, minimum volume since anomaly, and support remain UNKNOWN until rise/pullback segmentation and support rules are given.
phase_gaps.second_rise: Second rise, volume-supported rise, and volume-supported breakout are separate future date fields; no event date is invented without thresholds and a prior-high window.

rules: No forward data; windows use only bars through the row date. Numeric metrics are descriptive and do not certify a KB trading signal. No change to existing 57 labels or original formula.
